verdict.rationale: Proa states that WCAG and WAI-ARIA checks run during cargo build, so common accessibility markup defects fail before deploy. That is built-in, development-time accessibility checking with no separate audit tool. The claim is backed by compile-time template validation in the macro. missing for 10: detailed docs on which rules are checked and how warnings are surfaced or configured, independent or hands-on corroboration that the checks work as claimed.
